archetype: ELECTRIC & NEON (Future, Speed, Disruption) / AAA Cinematic

rules: Headlines (Size > 32px) MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter).
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use JetBrains Mono for numbers, manifesto chapters, poly-counts, stats.
No Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Retro-Futurism / Terminal Look mixed with Cinematic Glass
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) for gallery items. Use 'Tracing Beam' hover effects for active states.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain overlay across the entire site to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: High-contrast neon borders or aggressive text-color shifts (White to Neon Cyan) on hover.

layouts.general: High density, wide margins. Generous spacing (p-8 to p-16) for breathing room.
layouts.hero: Full screen (h-screen). Extreme asymmetry. Focus on the kinetic text reveal and background 3D/particle moment.
layouts.gallery: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix spans (col-span-4, col-span-8) to avoid boring identical squares.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters using massive JetBrains Mono typography. Scroll-triggered fades.
layouts.marquee: Massive outline text (text-8xl+ font-black text-transparent border-white/20) slow scrolling in the background for high energy.
layouts.footer: Massive typography 'LET\'S TALK' at text-[10vw], pure black background, simple email and social links (no forms).

components.hero_text: Framer Motion line-by-line masked text reveal. Overflow hidden on parent, translateY on child.
components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60), pure white text. MUST have Logo + Links + CTA.
components.gallery_filters: JetBrains Mono, uppercase, neon active state underline or glow.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), 1px border. Hover: filled neon background with black text.

motion.scroll: Lenis MUST be implemented for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Framer motion for all entrance animations (y: 40, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover scaling on gallery images (scale 1.05 with slow transition).
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee or framer motion for infinite horizontal scroll.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon/dark backgrounds meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: High contrast cyan outline on focus states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.hero_overlay: bg-black/40 with subtle linear gradient to pure black at the bottom. Never use generic flat blanket overlays.

3d_libraries.justification: Provides a subtle 3D parallax hero moment (e.g., floating digital embers or depth-based mouse movement) without the performance overhead of full WebGL, maintaining a cinematic feel.
3d_libraries.usage: Use as a background layer in the hero section, underneath the kinetic text reveal.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a dark, cinematic AAA sci-fi portfolio. Embrace pure #050505 backgrounds and neon accents.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use aggressive asymmetry.
Implement Lenis for momentum scrolling across the entire application.
Use Framer Motion to create the 'Kinetic Masked Text Reveal' in the hero. This means text lines translate up from outside a hidden overflow container.

Gallery MUST be filterable (Characters, Environments, Props) without navigating away. Clicking an item opens the Detail View (could be a full-screen Framer Motion shared layout transition or a separate route).
In the About/Manifesto section, use large numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) in JetBrains Mono.
The Contact footer should not have a form. Use a massive 'LET'S TALK' heading with email and social links.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the main App container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖, etc.). Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Create depth through layered z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur + saturate).
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds in headers/overlays if there's content underneath. Use black/60 with blur.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Rely on the provided media image URLs.
